M2-A01.description: Stuck event ingestion: card_published, awaiting_response, check_database ok, exact replay, reopen persistence

M2-A02.description: Start response: accepted, observing phase, observation deadline, check_database, exact replay, first-response-wins

M2-A03.description: Shrink response: next_card, phase awaiting_response, card_index grows, aggregate has multiple revisions

M2-A04.description: Blocked response: next_card, phase awaiting_response, card_index grows

M2-A05.description: Defer response: terminal_status completed, phase observing, check_database, reopen preserves terminal

M2-A06.description: Dismiss response: terminal_status completed, check_database ok

M2-A07.description: Card expiry: expired card rejects response, terminal_status appears, reopen preserves expiry

M2-A08.description: Observation completion via reconcile: overdue observation yields terminal, idempotent reconcile

M2-A09.description: Revision ceiling: max_card_revisions terminalizes after limit, check_database ok

M2-A10.description: Idempotent Stuck replay: same payload returns replay=True, single row in DB

M2-A11.description: Idempotent Response replay: same payload returns replay=True, result matches

M2-A12.description: Task change supersession: different revision yields superseded terminal, show confirms

M2-A13.description: check_database integrity: correct counts and version after start response

M2-A14.description: show: field presence, include_sensitive toggle, not-found raises

M2-A15.description: list_active: terminal excluded, non-terminal included with correct shape

M2-A16.description: reconcile: transitions overdue, idempotent, ok status

M2-A17.description: Restart resilience: all tables intact after close/reopen, phase preserved

M2-P01.description: Stuck TTL enforcement: expired Stuck refused, policy governs

M2-P02.description: Card TTL enforcement: expired card refuses response, terminal_status appears

M2-P03.description: Observation seconds enforcement: short observation triggers terminal on reconcile

M2-P04.description: max_card_revisions enforcement: non-default limit terminalizes shrink

M2-P05.description: max_resolution_tasks enforcement: too many tasks refused

M2-P06.description: Owner scoping: first-response-wins, second responder refused

M2-P07.description: Persisted policy survives restart with different policy

M2-P08.description: Custom task limits: resolution with fewer tasks than max is accepted

M2-P09.description: Conflict detection survives policy restart: changed payload refused

M2-E01.description: Observation with exact timestamps: specific timestamp persisted, durable through restart

M2-E02.description: Pre-Card observation: response timestamp before card issuance refused

M2-E03.description: Clock-skew boundary: response within tolerance accepted

M2-E04.description: Evidence durability: response evidence survives close/reopen

M2-E05.description: Exact replay with timestamps: replay returns byte-identical result

M2-V01.description: Bundle boundary shared: check_database, show, list_active, replay all reject same corruption

M2-V02.description: Corrupt aggregate rejected by show: corruption found by check_database also rejected by show

M2-V03.description: Corrupt message rejected by replay: corruption found by check_database also rejected by replay

M2-V04.description: Write validated before commit: failed writes leave no trace

M2-X01.description: Corruption exit code 5: corrupted DB returns exit 5 from CLI

M2-X02.description: Busy exit code 6: lock contention returns non-zero exit code

M2-X03.description: Storage exit code 7: uninitialized DB returns error exit code

M2-X04.description: Invalid input exit code 2: bad JSON returns exit 2

M2-X05.description: Not found exit code 3: unknown event_id returns exit 3

M2-X06.description: Refusal exit code 4: conflicting Stuck returns exit 4

M2-X07.description: Relative path exit code 2: relative state dir returns exit 2

M2-X08.description: Missing resolution exit code 2: omitted resolution input returns exit 2
